cards.card_text: Whoever touches the mountain is put to death, and no hand touches that person: they're stoned or shot with arrows.
cards.verse_text: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot with arrows—whether man or beast, he must not live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain.”

cards.verse_text: They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”
cards.snippet: They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”

cards.card_text: The elders and nobles of Naboth's city send word back to Jezebel: 'Naboth has been stoned to death.' Then Jezebel goes to her husband.
cards.verse_text: Then they sent word to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.” When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, “Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, who refused to give it to you for silver.
cards.snippet: Then they sent word to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.” When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death,…

cards.card_text: Hadoram, the man in charge of the forced labor, has been stoned to death.
cards.verse_text: Then King Rehoboam sent out Hadoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death.
cards.snippet: …Hadoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death.

cards.card_text: Paul's list goes on: he was stoned once, and the sea gave him trouble too.
cards.verse_text: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked.
cards.snippet: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked.

cards.card_text: They were stoned, sawed in two and put to death by the sword.
cards.verse_text: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword.

cards.verse_text: For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”
